prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1398; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you are comfortable with us recording this call?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe where you were when the collision happened.

A: I was driving on the highway in Sugar Land, in the middle of the afternoon. I was in the left lane heading toward the interchange.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?

A: I needed to move over to the right lane because my exit was coming up. I checked my mirror, I think, and then I started to change lanes.

Q: Did you use your turn signal?

A: I believe I did, but I'm not completely sure. Everything happened pretty fast.

Q: What happened next?

A: The other vehicle came up on my right side and we sideswiped each other. I heard a loud scrape and felt my car jolt. I tried to steer back into my lane and then I stopped on the shoulder.

Q: Did you hit your head at any point?

A: Yes. My head hit the window or the frame when the car shifted. I didn't lose consciousness, I don't think, but I was dizzy and had a headache right after.

Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that evening. They said I have a concussion and told me to rest and avoid screens for a while.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes, I still get headaches and I feel foggy sometimes, especially when I'm reading or looking at my phone for long periods.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get my car repaired and get better.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
